blocks.content: Here's a slight modification to the greet() function we previously created:

Hello Emma  
How do you do?
When you define the function as function greet(name), two important things happen:

items: A function named greet() is created.
A placeholder variable name is set up inside the function to accept a value (called an argument).

blocks.content: When you call the function using greet("Emma"), the following happens:

items: The string "Emma" is passed as an argument to the function.
This value is assigned to the name variable inside the function.
